interpretation.note: `delivered_any_form` counts filename evidence, not verified content. A basename match proves an artifact of that NAME exists somewhere tracked; it does not prove that artifact satisfies the unit's evidence_requirement or its completion_sentinel. Treat it as an upper bound on delivery and the at-declared-path count as the lower bound. UNIT-ID-REFERENCED is in neither.
